title: Sentinel Live Catalog Authentication Barrier
detail: https://cctv.corp8.cloud/cameras.json redirects to /auth/login with invite-only approval. Direct anonymous curl fails.
mitigation: Local validation source feeds active and tagged as LOCAL VALIDATION SOURCE; catalog adapter prepared for credentials injection.

title: PaddleOCR runtime dependency missing in container
detail: sentrax-backend-1 lacks paddleocr package, currently falling back to synthetic/default plate extraction.
mitigation: Integrate plate_detector.pt for precise plate cropping; test lightweight EasyOCR or localized OpenCV contour preprocessor.

title: Secret exposure risk in committed environment files
detail: Need to ensure no API keys or passwords are leaked in git history, client bundles or public reports.
mitigation: Run Security Agent baseline scan; verify .env in .gitignore and sanitize client build artifacts.
